title: Networking Fundamentals
description: Understand how the internet works from the ground up. Master the OSI model, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, firewalls, and load balancers — essential knowledge for every DevOps engineer.
objectives: Explain the OSI model and TCP/IP layers
Understand TCP vs UDP and when to use each
Explain how DNS resolves domain names to IP addresses
Understand HTTP/HTTPS, status codes, and TLS
Configure firewalls and understand load balancing
